tasks.title: Define and Refine AI Model Requirements

steps.description: Gather and document business requirements and stakeholder expectations for the AI model.
Analyze existing data sources and identify relevant data for training and testing the AI model.
Determine the key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the AI model's success and effectiveness.
Develop a detailed product roadmap and timeline for the AI model's development and deployment.
Create a comprehensive data quality and validation plan to ensure the AI model's accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and integration of the AI model with existing systems and processes.
Conduct market research and analyze competitor AI models to identify opportunities for differentiation and improvement.
Develop a plan for ongoing model maintenance, updates, and retraining to ensure the AI model remains accurate and effective.
Create a plan for monitoring and evaluating the AI model's performance and impact on the business.
Communicate the AI model's requirements, roadmap, and progress to stakeholders and ensure their feedback and input are incorporated.

tasks.title: Develop and Manage AI Model Training Data

steps.description: Identify and collect relevant data sources for training the AI model.
Clean, preprocess, and transform the data into a suitable format for training the AI model.
Split the data into training, validation, and testing sets to ensure the AI model's accuracy and generalizability.
Develop a data augmentation plan to increase the diversity and size of the training data.
Create a data quality and validation plan to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the training data.
Collaborate with data engineers and scientists to design and implement a data pipeline for data ingestion, processing, and storage.
Develop a plan for ongoing data collection, updating, and refinement to ensure the AI model remains accurate and effective.
Create a plan for data governance and compliance to ensure the responsible use of data and adherence to regulations.
Communicate the data requirements, collection plan, and progress to stakeholders and ensure their feedback and input are incorporated.
Monitor and evaluate the quality and effectiveness of the training data and make adjustments as needed.
Identify and engage with relevant stakeholders and teams, including data scientists, engineers, and product managers.
Develop a shared understanding of the AI model's goals, objectives, and requirements with cross-functional teams.
Collaborate with data scientists to design and develop the AI model's architecture and algorithms.
Work with engineers to design and implement the AI model's deployment and integration with existing systems.
Partner with product managers to develop a product roadmap and timeline for the AI model's development and deployment.
Communicate the AI model's progress, challenges, and results to cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Facilitate feedback and input from cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure the AI model meets their needs and expectations.
Develop a plan for ongoing collaboration and knowledge sharing between cross-functional teams to ensure the AI model's continued success.
Identify and address any conflicts or issues that arise during collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Evaluate the effectiveness of collaboration with cross-functional teams and identify areas for improvement.

tasks.title: Monitor and Evaluate AI Model Performance

steps.description: Develop a plan for monitoring and evaluating the AI model's performance and impact on the business.
Collect and analyze data on the AI model's performance, including metrics such as accuracy, precision, and recall.
Visualize the AI model's performance data using dashboards and reports to facilitate understanding and decision-making.
Identify areas for improvement and develop a plan for addressing them, including retraining the AI model or adjusting its parameters.
Communicate the AI model's performance and results to stakeholders and ensure their feedback and input are incorporated.
Develop a plan for ongoing monitoring and evaluation of the AI model's performance to ensure its continued accuracy and effectiveness.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to refine the AI model and improve its performance over time.
Identify and address any biases or ethical concerns in the AI model's performance and develop a plan for mitigating them.
Develop a plan for explaining and interpreting the AI model's results and decisions to stakeholders and end-users.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the monitoring and evaluation plan and identify areas for improvement.

tasks.title: Develop and Manage AI Model Deployment Strategy

steps.description: Develop a plan for deploying the AI model in production, including integration with existing systems and infrastructure.
Collaborate with engineers to design and implement the AI model's deployment architecture and infrastructure.
Develop a plan for monitoring and logging the AI model's performance and errors in production.
Create a plan for rolling out the AI model to end-users, including training and support materials.
Develop a plan for ongoing maintenance and updates of the AI model, including retraining and redeployment.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the AI model's deployment aligns with business goals and objectives.
Develop a plan for addressing any technical debt or issues that arise during the AI model's deployment.
Create a plan for evaluating the AI model's performance and impact in production, including metrics and KPIs.
Develop a plan for refining and improving the AI model over time, including retraining and updating.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the deployment strategy and identify areas for improvement.
